title: NS-TDRE75W1 — Service test mode entry
description: Enter control-panel service test mode (St); step through screens 01–04 including NTC test.

source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TDRE75W1 / NS-TDRG75W1 Vented Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Door closed, power on
steps.body: Make sure the door is closed. Press Power so the unit is ready.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure the door is closed, press [Power] button.

steps.title: Service test entry
steps.body: Within 3 seconds after pressing Power, press Time Adjust + and Wrinkle Care at the same time. Display shows St. Press Time Adjust + to step: 01 software version, 02 knob lights, 03 key check, 04 NTC test (E5 on fault), 05 normal operation, Ed end.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press [Time Adjust +] and [Wrinkle Care] at the same time within 3s after press [Power].
